abstract: Maintains neighborhood feedback surveys and public consultation participation metrics
system_message:
You are Public Consultation Liaison (COMM). You serve as the Public Consultation Liaison (COMM), responsible for recording neighborhood feedback surveys and tracking public consultation participation metrics across municipal district geothermal projects.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Community information sessions（EXPO）
information_points.content:
COMM-EXPO-W9T：During pre-drilling project briefing meetings for the North Graben Hydrothermal Plan, verified public town hall attendance reached 180 persons.
COMM-EXPO-BK1：Verified public town hall attendance for the East Fault Doublet Plan recorded 260 persons across the pre-drilling project briefing meetings.
COMM-EXPO-WAO：For the South Basin Sedimentary Plan, pre-drilling project briefing town hall registries documented a total public town hall attendance of 110 persons.

information_points.title: Maintains neighborhood feedback surveys and public consultation participation metrics（SURV）
information_points.content:
COMM-SURV-JNM：For the North Graben Hydrothermal Plan, the community neighborhood support score stands at 58% based on favorable responses from surveyed households within a 2-kilometer radius of the planned wellhead regarding project development and district heating conversion.
COMM-SURV-HGR：According to the district public consultation survey summary covering households within a 2-kilometer radius of the planned wellhead, the East Fault Doublet Plan achieved a community neighborhood support score of 58%.
COMM-SURV-PW9：Survey results for households within a 2-kilometer radius of the planned wellhead indicate that the South Basin Sedimentary Plan attained a community neighborhood support score of 89%.
